A year of complaining about a big tree, and one March morning.
The tree next door
noisy, annoying
dark, gloomy
strong, powerful

entries.anchor: m18/story:ja-m18-the-tree-next-door/ja:「いまは ふゆです。はなが ありません。」
entries.en: "It's winter now. There are no flowers."

entries.anchor: m18/story:ja-m18-the-tree-next-door/ja:「その きは おおきいです。ぼくの へやが くらいです。」
entries.en: "That tree is big. My room is dark."

entries.anchor: m18/story:ja-m18-the-tree-next-door/ja:あきに かぜが つよい。
entries.en: In autumn the wind is strong.

entries.anchor: m18/story:ja-m18-the-tree-next-door/ja:ある あさ、まどを あける。
entries.en: One morning I open the window.

entries.anchor: m18/story:ja-m18-the-tree-next-door/ja:いまは この きが すきだ。
entries.en: Now I like this tree.

entries.anchor: m18/story:ja-m18-the-tree-next-door/ja:うちの となりに おおきな にわが ある。
entries.en: Next door to my house there's a big garden.

entries.anchor: m18/story:ja-m18-the-tree-next-door/ja:かぜの よるは とても うるさい。
entries.en: Windy nights are very noisy.

entries.anchor: m18/story:ja-m18-the-tree-next-door/ja:きに はなが ある。
entries.en: There are flowers on the tree.

entries.anchor: m18/story:ja-m18-the-tree-next-door/ja:きは さくらだった。
entries.en: The tree was a cherry tree.

entries.anchor: m18/story:ja-m18-the-tree-next-door/ja:きは ぼくの へやの まどの まえだ。
entries.en: The tree is right in front of my room's window.

entries.anchor: m18/story:ja-m18-the-tree-next-door/ja:さんがつ、てんきが まいにち あたたかい。
entries.en: In March the weather is warm every day.

entries.anchor: m18/story:ja-m18-the-tree-next-door/ja:その はなしが わからない。
entries.en: I don't understand that.

entries.anchor: m18/story:ja-m18-the-tree-next-door/ja:つぎの ふゆも ぼくは まつ。
entries.en: Next winter too, I'll wait for it.

entries.anchor: m18/story:ja-m18-the-tree-next-door/ja:となりの にわは とても きれいだ。
entries.en: The garden next door is beautiful.

entries.anchor: m18/story:ja-m18-the-tree-next-door/ja:となりの ひとは 「はるは きれいです。」と はなす。
entries.en: The person next door says, "It's beautiful in spring."

entries.anchor: m18/story:ja-m18-the-tree-next-door/ja:なつは あつい。けど、きの したは すずしい。
entries.en: Summer is hot. But it's cool under the tree.

entries.anchor: m18/story:ja-m18-the-tree-next-door/ja:にわの なかに とても おおきな きが ある。
entries.en: In the garden there's a very big tree.

entries.anchor: m18/story:ja-m18-the-tree-next-door/ja:ふゆ、きの うえに ゆきが ある。
entries.en: In winter there's snow on the tree.

entries.anchor: m18/story:ja-m18-the-tree-next-door/ja:ふゆの きは ぜんぜん きれいじゃない。
entries.en: The winter tree isn't beautiful at all.

entries.anchor: m18/story:ja-m18-the-tree-next-door/ja:ぼくの へやの まどの まえに さくらが ある。
entries.en: There's a cherry tree in front of my window.

entries.anchor: m18/story:ja-m18-the-tree-next-door/ja:ぼくは きょねんから この まちに すむ。
entries.en: I've lived in this town since last year.

entries.anchor: m18/story:ja-m18-the-tree-next-door/ja:ぼくは この きが すきじゃない。
entries.en: I don't like this tree.

entries.anchor: m18/story:ja-m18-the-tree-next-door/ja:ぼくは となりの ひとに はなす。
entries.en: I speak to the person next door.

entries.anchor: m18/story:ja-m18-the-tree-next-door/ja:まちの ひとが にわの まえに くる。ひとは しゃしんを とる。
entries.en: People from the town come to the front of the garden. They take photos.
